name: AndroidLab
description: AndroidLab is a systematic Android agent framework that includes an operation environment with different modalities, action space, and a reproducible benchmark. It supports both large language models and multimodal models, featuring predefined Android virtual devices and 138 tasks across nine apps for evaluating autonomous Android agents.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is gaining attention in the Android-agent community, but it is not yet as widely established as long-running mobile evaluation suites.
notes: Includes both LLMs and LMMs evaluation; open-sourced and publicly available.
